services.desc: Bass - slow due to summertime heat and boat traffic. The fish have moved off shore and it's difficult to fish for Bass due to the amount of boat traffic during the summer. Once we get past Mid September, the bass will move shallow again and we'll start doing Bass Trips again. Perch - the white perch bite is on fire,
